verses.text: Dear friends, since we have these promises, let's cleanse ourselves from everything that contaminates body and spirit, bringing holiness to completion in reverence for God.
Make room for us in your hearts. We haven't wronged anyone, corrupted anyone, or taken advantage of anyone.
I'm not saying this to condemn you. I've already told you that you're in our hearts—to live together and to die together.
I can speak to you with great confidence. I'm very proud of you. I'm filled with comfort and overflowing with joy, even through all our troubles.
Even when we arrived in Macedonia, we had no rest. We were troubled in every way: conflicts on the outside, fears within.
But God, who comforts the downcast, comforted us through Titus' arrival,
and not only through his arrival. You also comforted him. He told us about your longing, your sorrow, and your concern for me, and that made me even more joyful.
Even though my letter made you sad, I don't regret writing it. I did regret it for a while, because I saw that it upset you, though only briefly.
Now I'm glad—not because you were made sad, but because your sorrow led you to turn back to God. You were grieved in a way that honors God, so you suffered no loss because of us.
Godly sorrow leads to a change of heart that brings salvation and leaves no regret. But worldly sorrow leads to death.

Look what this godly sorrow produced in you: real concern, a desire to clear things up, indignation, alarm, longing, commitment, and a desire for justice. In every way, you showed yourselves to be innocent in this matter.
So even though I wrote to you, it wasn't on behalf of the one who did wrong or the one who was wronged. I wrote so your concern for us would be clear before God.
That's why we've been comforted. And our comfort has been made even greater by the joy Titus felt, because you all refreshed his spirit.
If I had bragged to him about you, I wasn't put to shame. Just as everything we told you was true, our boasting to Titus proved true too.
His affection for you has grown even stronger as he remembers how you all obeyed and welcomed him with fear and trembling.
I'm glad I can be completely confident in you.
